data:
Apple's diluted earnings per share were $6.08 in fiscal 2024 (year ended September 28, 2024), down from $6.13 in fiscal 2023 (year ended September 30, 2023). That is a decline of $0.05, or about 0.8%. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $93,736 million (about $93.7 billion), down from $96,995 million in fiscal 2023.

The decline came despite operating income rising to $123,216 million from $114,301 million. The main reason was a much higher provision for income taxes, which rose to $29,749 million from $16,741 million. Fewer diluted shares outstanding (15,408,095 thousand versus 15,812,547 thousand) limited the drop in EPS.
